parse_sections: 第一步：通读全文，识别义项
Step one: read the whole source and identify semantic units
第二步：统一身份，建立事件和产物关系
Step two: unify identities and link events and artifacts
第三步：给每条要求绑定模态与作用域
Step three: attach modality and scope to each requirement
第四步：补齐可计算关系，而不是补造任务要求
Step four: complete computable relations without inventing requirements
第五步：编码成同一份候选IR
Step five: encode one candidate IR
第六步：原文与IR双向复核后输出
Step six: check both source-to-IR and IR-to-source before returning
audit_sections: 语言适用与跨语言审阅
一、从原文检查是否漏了边界
One: check the source for omitted boundaries
二、从IR检查是否增加或改变原意
Two: check IR for invented or changed meaning
三、用反事实检查语义效力，不计算最终答案
Three: test semantic effectiveness without calculating the answer
四、按实际支持范围出具审阅记录
Four: issue review records matching actual support
